import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    tam = int(data[0].strip())
    cad = data[1].strip() if len(data) > 1 else ""

    arr = []
    word = []
    cont = 0
    mayor = 0
    flg = False

    for i, c in enumerate(cad):
        if c == '(':
            if cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            cont = 0
            flg = True
        elif c == ')':
            flg = False
            if word:
                arr.append(''.join(word))
                word.clear()
        else:
            if flg:
                if c != '_':
                    word.append(c)
                elif word:
                    arr.append(''.join(word))
                    word.clear()
            else:
                if c != '_':
                    cont += 1
                    if i == tam - 1 and cont >= mayor:
                        mayor = cont
                else:
                    if cont >= mayor:
                        mayor = cont
                    cont = 0

    print(f"{mayor} {len(arr)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
